statement:
∀ (S : Set (Space n × ℝ)), IsOpen S →
Set.EqOn (Function.uncurry u) (fun _ => q) S →
∀ (k : ℕ) (p : Space n × ℝ), 0 < k → p ∈ S →
iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Function.uncurry u) p = 0
proof:
intro S hS hu k p hk hp
have he : Function.uncurry u =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ => q) :=
  (hS.mem_nhds hp).mono (fun z hz => hu hz)
have hd := (he.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds
rw [hd, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)]
rfl
